rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Magical wild ass destroying the prison bars with one kick.

visual_requirements.description: One wild ass with four legs and two long ass ears; no wings.
One kick destroys the prison bars and stone jambs.
Prison where D. Diogo is held.

aura: Ancaman dari satu tendangan yang menghancurkan jeruji dan jamb batu (pardalo-c07), tanpa aura generik.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of PARDALO, the Portuguese magical wild ass.
ANATOMY: ONE rugged wild ass, exactly four legs, two long ass ears, one head, powerful small equine body, no wings or horns [pardalo-c01].
MOMENT: rear kicking violently into an enormous iron prison grille while the head turns sharply toward the viewer; dynamic three-quarter side view, full body readable.
POWER: a SINGLE rear kick has smashed the iron prison grille down and shattered both heavy stone jambs into hundreds of flying fragments; broken bars fly toward the camera, a cramped human prisoner stands beyond for scale [pardalo-c02,c07]. Show the impossible destruction happening at direct hoof contact, much greater than ordinary donkey strength.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle close to flying bars, animal fills most square, head fully visible with ears not cropped; four separated legs identifiable.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm torch beyond broken gate, strong rim light, thick dust lit in flight.
SURFACE: shaggy dark donkey coat, strained tendons, battered iron, shattered rough stone.
SETTING: medieval prison doorway [pardalo-c02,c07].
MOOD: supernatural ferocity and unstoppable physical force, dangerous and imposing, never farm animal at pasture.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads/limbs; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

visual_review.notes: Four legs, two long ears, head fully visible; rear kick breaks bars and heavy stone jamb at contact, no magical glow. Strong destructive moment c07. Native and 200px inspected.
